scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter @cerebero/server build && bun run --filter @cerebero/web build
scripts.build:packages: bun run --filter @cerebero/contracts build && bun run --filter @cerebero/db build && bun run --filter @cerebero/ui build
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.dev: bun run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,web --prefix-colors green,blue "bun run --filter @cerebero/server dev" "bun run --filter @cerebero/web dev"
scripts.test: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter @cerebero/contracts test && bun run --filter @cerebero/db test && bun run --filter @cerebero/ui test && bun run --filter @cerebero/server test && bun run --filter @cerebero/web test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @cerebero/contracts typecheck && bun run --filter @cerebero/db typecheck && bun run --filter @cerebero/ui typecheck && bun run --filter @cerebero/server typecheck && bun run --filter @cerebero/web typecheck
